run.question: A colleague cites the RTDFS overview as a table of completed flight measurements. Is that citation adequate?
run.answer:
The RTDFS (Radiation Tolerance of DNA Fragments) investigation page on science.nasa.gov describes the scientific objectives of the experiment, such as studying the effects of radiation on DNA, rather than listing completed flight measurement data.

Citing an overview page focused on scientific objectives is generally inadequate for supporting a claim that specific flight measurements have been completed, as such pages do not typically contain the resulting data tables or final results.
